title: Compound landslide and flash flood events in the Chittagong Hill Tracts: analysis code and derived data
description:
Analysis code, derived data and the claims register for a study of three compound landslide and flash flood events on the same slopes and rivers of south-eastern Bangladesh: June 2017, August 2023 and July 2026.

The archive contains the ERA5-Land and GPM IMERG retrieval scripts, the hourly de-accumulation and gauge-anchoring analysis, the rainfall threshold-crossing calculation, the rainfall-based date audit of the landslide inventory, the figure scripts, and a claims register recording the source and status of every quantitative claim in the study.

The three figures rebuild from the cached point series included here, with no downloads. The full rainfall analysis requires the ERA5-Land and IMERG NetCDF files, which are retrieved by the included scripts rather than redistributed.

Licensing: source code in data/scripts/ and figures/ is released under the MIT Licence. Derived data in data/ and the claims register in review/ are released under CC BY 4.0. Both licence texts are included in the archive.

Underlying ERA5-Land, GPM IMERG and landslide-inventory data carry the terms of their respective providers and are not redistributed.
